title: Battle of Aldie
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Aldie", at revision 1370401359, opens: "The Battle of Aldie took place on June 17, 1863, in Loudoun County, Virginia, as part of the Gettysburg campaign of the American Civil War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q766479, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1863 American Civil War battle in the Gettysburg Campaign". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
